messages:
Eli: idea for a compact launch webinar tied to the upcoming benchmark post. goal: practical playbook for product teams + one customer highlight. 30-40m.
Noor: 👍 keep it action-first. people should leave with 3 things they can ship.
Sam: agree. proposed structure: 3x 8-10m segments (problem, demo, artifact) + 10m Q&A. short and tactical.
Priya: volunteer to host and do the ops checklist. can someone own the bench demo? Jared?
Jared: I can lead bench demo. will show baseline -> batching -> cache -> model routing, each with p50/p95 and cost delta.
Eli: good. ask marketing to call out a sanitized ROI stat in hero (e.g., "~30% token spend reduction in pilot"). Legal ok?
Noor: confirm with legal, but we can use "~30%" as sanitized stat for now.
EventBot: New event draft created: "Launch Playbook: 3 levers to cut token spend" - link https://events.redwood.example/d/launch-playbook-xyz
Sam: rehearsal plan: tech check (30m) + full run (45m). windows Tue/Wed next week. prefer Wed morning.
Priya: booking Wed 10:00 PT for full run, Tue 09:30 PT for tech check. invites incoming.
Jared: will prerecord a 90s fallback clip and the demo CLI outputs. putting artifacts in drive.
Eli: marketing tasks: 3 headline variants, 1-line hook, 2-sentence blurb, TL;DR bullets, CTAs. Sam, can you draft headlines?
Sam: will post 3 headline options by EOD. also propose A/B test two CTAs on landing page.
Priya: run-of-show draft:
0:00 - 0:30 Welcome & goals (Priya)
0:30 - 5:00 Customer highlight (pre-recorded or live)
5:00 - 20:00 Bench playbook demo (Jared)
20:00 - 28:00 Ops checklist + downloads (Priya)
28:00 - 40:00 Live Q&A + poll (All)
Noor: assets to collect before tech check: 1) landing copy + CTAs (Sam) 2) demo notebook + fallback clip (Jared) 3) cue cards + checklist (Priya).
Jared: demo notes: pin model version and show fallback to quantized variant. snippet I'll use: `export MODEL_ID=redwood-2b && ./run_demo --model $MODEL_ID --fallback redwood-2b-q`
Sam: social plan: 20s pre-event clip, two hero CTAs (request checklist / watch demo), and LinkedIn + X copy.
Priya: follow-up plan: recording + 1-page checklist + link to request a free cost review. draft email after rehearsal.
EventBot: Rehearsal scheduled: Tue 09:30 PT (tech check) and Wed 10:00 PT (full run). Calendar invites sent.
Eli: final asks: Sam share headlines, Jared upload artifacts, Priya finalize cue cards. reconvene at tech check. :rocket:
